summary: The reconciliation verifier now binds every redirected packet to an explicit successor agreed by all REDIRECTED graph nodes that share that packet, and rejects any receipt that disagrees.
changes: scripts/run_slice.py: replaced the single global reconciliation successor assumption with per-node graph bindings and fail-closed graph validation.
tests/test_slice_contexts.py: added valid multiple-successor and invalid binding coverage while preserving historical reconciliation checks.
behavior: A REDIRECTED node requires a unique id, a nonempty packet path, and a non-self redirected_to target that exists in the graph. Nodes sharing a packet must name the same successor.
Each receipt source must name a redirected packet and its successor_packet_id must exactly equal that packet's graph binding.
Ledger checkpoint, duplicate, event, historical-evidence, canonical-path, and exact redirected-set checks remain unchanged.
remaining_work: Sol must add the explicit graph bindings and append the three truthful receipts to the existing core stream without changing its eight historical records.
The integrated candidate requires full Git Bash validation and an independent audit.
